query: A binding decree will require telecommunications operators to meet climate-resilience standards.
National technical standards will require climate-resilient infrastructure design.
Mandatory climate-risk screening will be incorporated into the sector investment appraisal procedure.
Formal sector operating protocols will require service continuity during climate shocks.
A sector policy and action plan will establish explicit climate-resilience requirements.
The telecommunications regulator will adopt mandatory climate-resilience requirements for future network investments.
